NEET (UG) 2024 — Full Mock Test

Test Booklet Code S6  •  National Testing Agency (Final Answer Key, revised 26.07.2024)

📋 Important Instructions

  • The test is of 3 hours 20 minutes duration and contains 200 multiple-choice questions from Physics, Chemistry and Biology (Botany and Zoology). 50 questions in each subject, divided into two Sections.
  • Section A has 35 questions per subject — all compulsory.
  • Section B has 15 questions per subject — attempt any 10. If you answer more than 10, only the first 10 answered (by question number) will be evaluated.
  • Each question carries 4 marks. +4 for every correct answer, −1 for every incorrect answer. Unattempted questions get 0. Maximum marks: 720.
  • Use "Save & Next" to save your response and move on. Use "Mark for Review & Next" to flag a question for later.
  • You can navigate freely between subjects and questions using the question palette.
  • The test will auto-submit when the timer reaches zero.
  • This answer key is the revised key issued pursuant to the Hon'ble Supreme Court's order dated 23.07.2024 in W.P.(Civil) No. 335/2024.
  • You may switch the question language between English and Hindi at any time during the test.

📚 Syllabus / Structure

PhysicsQ. 1–35 (A) · 36–50 (B)
ChemistryQ. 51–85 (A) · 86–100 (B)
BotanyQ. 101–135 (A) · 136–150 (B)
ZoologyQ. 151–185 (A) · 186–200 (B)
